Excellent! All 106 tests pass. I've successfully added customer ID normalization:

✅ **Added normalizeId(id) to src/customers.js**
- Trims whitespace
- Converts to uppercase
- Handles mixed case and spaces: `'c-007 '` → `'C-007'`

✅ **Updated getCustomer**
- Normalizes ID before lookup
- Finds customers regardless of case or whitespace: `'c-001'`, `'C-001'`, `' c-001 '` all work

✅ **Updated createInvoice**
- Normalizes customerId before validation
- Stores normalized ID in returned invoice
- Enables invoice tracking with consistent ID format

✅ **7 new tests** covering:
- normalizeId function (trim + uppercase)
- getCustomer with various ID formats
- createInvoice stores normalized ID
- Case-insensitive and space-tolerant lookups

The system now handles customer IDs from other systems robustly—trailing spaces, leading spaces, lowercase, uppercase, and mixed case are all normalized consistently.
